summary: Extended interaction reliability behavioral coverage in the same gate-listed backend/frontend test files. Backend interaction contract suite now passes (35 tests). Interaction gate currently fails due one new frontend reliability assertion: malformed suggested_actions causes runtime crash in extractSuggestions.

minor.issue: Conflict guard is phrase-sensitive; 'Never modify files' did not trigger conflict while 'Never modify any files' did. This is a heuristic boundary, not a deterministic validator.

ui_bugs.issue: Crashes when interaction.suggested_actions contains malformed entries (e.g., null) because filter reads action.type without guarding null.
ui_bugs.selector: N/A (utility-layer failure surfaced by unit test)

integration_issues.issue: Gate returns non-zero due failing frontend reliability test for malformed suggested_actions handling.

action_items: Fix extractSuggestions to ignore malformed action entries safely (null/non-object/missing string label) before filtering by type.
Re-run scripts/interaction_gate.sh after frontend fix; expected to return zero if no other regressions.
Optional hardening: broaden conflict phrase handling if product expects semantically equivalent no-edit constraints beyond current pattern-based detector.

Tool-failure recurrence coverage now verifies one-turn repeated failures do NOT satisfy multi-turn recurrence threshold (prevents false positives).
Baseline pyflakes warnings in local_tools/stream/worker are unchanged from commit 27f428d7 (verified via git show + pyflakes on archived sources).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Key remaining blocker is frontend utility robustness: malformed suggested_actions currently throws. Gate pass state before this extension: /app/test_reports/interaction_audit_after_gate_rerun.txt (all pass). After extension: /app/test_reports/interaction_audit_after_gate_rerun_v3.txt (single frontend fail). Broad regression was started with default flag OFF: frontend full yarn test completed (preexisting multi-file failures + new interaction test failure logged), backend full pytest run was bounded and manually stopped at ~10% progress with multiple existing failures already observed in log; no full clean-claim.
rca of the issue: Root cause for gate failure: extractSuggestions assumes every suggested_actions element is an object and dereferences action.type directly. Null/malformed entries trigger TypeError before graceful fallback. Reproduction: call extractSuggestions('irrelevant', {interaction:{version:1,suggested_actions:[null,{type:'reply'}]}}) path exercised in src/utils/__tests__/interactionReliability.test.jsx. Mitigation: normalize action list with object/type guards before property access, then keep existing type/label validation.
